backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister with persisted state, authorization and storage mixins, user profiles, pairing, scheduling, filtering, activity, location, and audit-log types and maps.
backend/migration.mo: Implements migration from older user profile and audit log formats to the new schema including added fields like profile photos and accountDeleted entries.
feature_evidence.json: Provides feature-to-file mapping evidence for UI account dropdown, profile photo, password flow, and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short functional summaries of all major frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS layers and theme tokens for light and dark mode styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file loading the React app and setting metadata, icons, and theme color.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Web app manifest configuring PWA metadata, icons, theme colors, and categories.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling caching, fetch fallback, and queued background sync for location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication state, user role routing, loading screens, and layout for parent, child, and admin views.
frontend/src/components/account/AccountD: User account dropdown showing profile actions like changing photo, password, viewing policies, and deleting the account.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePa: Dialog guiding users to change their Internet Identity password via external link with explanatory text.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePr: Dialog for uploading, previewing, removing, and saving a new profile photo with validation and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/account/DeleteAc: Confirmation dialog requiring typed input before allowing account deletion using a mutation.
frontend/src/components/account/UserAvat: User avatar component displaying profile photos or initials in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Empty placeholder file for an admin accounts table component.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Admin-only password gate allowing password verification and allowlisted admins to change the admin password.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays admin dashboard metric cards using fetched metrics, showing loading skeletons until data loads.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's daily activity alerts relative to schedule limits and allows requesting more time when over limit.
Shows a parent's view of a child's daily activity status compared to limits with summary alerts.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays a sortable audit log table of child‑related actions with timestamps and executors.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication states and errors.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Provides a modal for users to set up name, role, and optional parent phone number with allowlist checks before saving.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Lists a child's activity history in a sortable table with optional transparency label and periodic refetching.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Provides child check‑in UI for submitting activities, manual location updates, and toggling live location sharing.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Renders a warning notice describing consent requirements for activity, location, or pairing actions.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Displays a child's location history with filtering, pagination limits, and map links.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Handles pairing a child to a parent using a code or phone number with validation and status polling.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Lets parents configure content filter categories, allowlists, and blocklists for a child.
Shows a read‑only view of the child's content filter policy including categories and lists.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Dropdown for switching the app's language between supported locales.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: App footer showing copyright info, a policies link, and attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header bar showing app name, user menu, theme toggle, language selector, and login button, with optional policy button.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Displays a transparency notice and a live-updating list of a child’s activity history.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Card summarizing a child's recent activity and location counts, with selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Shows the child’s latest shared location, live‑sharing status, timestamps, and a map link with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Tabbed interface for viewing a child’s live location map or location history with a transparency notice.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates, displays, and copies a parent–child pairing code with warnings and loading states.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Lets parents view, edit, validate, and save their phone number with status alerts.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Allows parents to configure daily screen‑time limits and editable time windows for a child.
Displays a read‑only schedule with daily limits and allowed time windows fetched via useGetSchedule.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Provides a simple sessionStorage-based flag for gating admin access with pass and clear functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Exposes the i18n context hook for accessing translations and language settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, loading, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Periodically captures and submits geolocation data with queueing, retry, and background sync support.
Sends periodic presence heartbeats to the backend when authenticated and on visibility changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, activity, location, schedule, and various backend interactions.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides language state, persistence, and translation lookup for supported locales.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports translation dictionaries, supported locales, and translation key types.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: English translation dictionary containing UI strings for authentication, profile setup, dialogs, menus, and general app text.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Brazilian Portuguese translation dictionary mirroring the English version with localized UI strings.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables, navy color tokens, and base element styling.
frontend/src/lib/leafletMarkerIcon.ts: Empty placeholder file for Leaflet marker icon utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that initializes React, sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard page showing admin info, metrics cards, and a placeholder management tab with i18n support.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child home dashboard showing welcome text, supervision notice, optional parent pairing, and tabs for check-in, history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard UI displaying children, pairing requests, and multiple management panels with tabs and child selection.
Modal page displaying transparency and data policies using i18n strings and structured card sections.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers the service worker and exposes helpers for background sync, periodic sync, and retrieving the registration.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects device and PWA capabilities related to geolocation and background sync, and produces user-facing capability messages.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: Implements a persistent local queue for storing and retrying location updates with size and retry limits.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Provides phone number normalization, validation, formatting, parsing, and allowlist comparison utilities.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using both query strings and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, color variables, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking schema version, features, requests, and metadata for development planning.
